div.head: Af 1.4
div.ab: Gif hine man togenydan scyle, ⁊ he elles nylle, gif hine man gebinde, þolie his wæpna and his yrfes.
Gif hine mon togenedan scyle, ⁊ he elles nylle, gif hine mon gebinde, þolige his wæpna ⁊ his ierfes.
Et si cogi oporteat et aliter nolit, si ligetur, perdat arma sua cum tota pecunia sua.
Gif hine mon togenedan scyle, ⁊ he elles nylle, gif hine mon gebinde, þolige his wæpna ⁊ his ierfes.
If he has to be forced thither, and he resists, if he needs to be bound, let him forfeit his weapons and his property.
If he will not submit unless force is used against him, [i.e.] if he has to be bound, he shall forfeit his weapons and his property.
If he has to be forced thither, and will not go otherwise, and he is bound, he is to forfeit his weapons and his possessions.
Wenn man ihn zur [Gefängnisstrafe] zwingen muss, und er anders nicht [sich fügen] will, wenn man ihn bindet, so verliere er seine Waffen und sein Eigenthum.
If he has to be compelled [to the imprisonment], and will not [submit] otherwise, if he is bound, let him forfeit his weapons and his property.
